name: Vehicle

fields.label: Registration / Fleet Number
fields.description: Enter the road registration plate, or the internal fleet number for off-road machinery. Use one stable identifier for every unit.

fields.label: Vehicle Make
fields.description: Select an active manufacturer; available models are filtered by this make.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Select an active model belonging to the selected make.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Owning company for this vehicle and its stock transactions.

fields.label: Vehicle / Equipment Category
fields.options:
Truck
Dump Truck
Tractor Unit
Trailer
Semi-trailer
Tanker
Pickup
Utility Vehicle
Bulldozer
Wheel Loader
Excavator
Backhoe Loader
Motor Grader
Road Roller
Asphalt Paver
Concrete Mixer Truck
Concrete Pump
Mobile Crane
Bridge Crane
Forklift
Water Tanker
Fuel Tanker
Low-bed Trailer
Compressor
Generator
Sweeper
Other Equipment
fields.description: Choose the road vehicle or public-works machine type.

fields.label: Year of Manufacture
fields.description: Year the vehicle was manufactured

fields.label: Chassis Number
fields.description: VIN / Chassis Number — unique vehicle identifier

fields.label: Engine Number
fields.description: Engine serial number

fields.label: Weight Class (Optional)
fields.description: Use for road vehicles where applicable; leave blank for equipment if this classification is not meaningful.

fields.label: Tonnage
fields.description: Payload capacity in tonnes

fields.label: Number of Axles
fields.description: Total number of axles

fields.label: Fuel Capacity (L)
fields.description: Fuel tank capacity in litres

fields.label: Current Odometer (km)
fields.description: Latest recorded odometer reading in km

fields.label: Acquisition Date
fields.description: Date the vehicle was acquired

fields.label: Acquisition Value (DZD)
fields.description: Purchase value in Algerian Dinars

fields.label: Current Value (DZD)
fields.description: Current book value (after depreciation)

fields.label: Depreciation Rate (%)
fields.description: Annual depreciation rate as percentage

fields.label: Salvage Value (DZD)
fields.description: Estimated residual value at end of useful life

fields.label: Insurance Value (DZD)
fields.description: Insured value of the vehicle

fields.label: Vehicle Documents
fields.description: Store the vehicle's registration certificate (carte grise), insurance, technical inspection and each renewal here. Attach the scanned file to each row.

fields.label: Registration Document
fields.description: Carte grise / registration certificate

fields.label: Insurance Document
fields.description: Insurance certificate

fields.label: Pollution Certificate
fields.description: Pollution Under Control certificate

fields.label: Technical Inspection Certificate
fields.description: Technical inspection (visite technique)

fields.label: Vehicle Documents
fields.description: Add one row per document: choose its type, enter issue and expiry dates, then upload the scan in the Attachment column. Open the attachment to view or print the original document. Status is updated automatically using the configured alert window.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Active
In Service
Out of Service
Under Repair
Retired
Scrapped

fields.label: Current Location
fields.description: Base depot or current worksite

fields.label: Parts Warehouse
fields.description: Source warehouse used when maintenance parts are issued.

fields.label: Primary Driver / Operator
fields.description: Regular road driver or equipment operator, where assigned.

fields.label: Company Classification
fields.description: Grade classification of the owning company (I-IX)

fields.label: Asset
fields.description: Optional ERPNext fixed asset; it must belong to the same Company.

description: Vehicle records for Sotrama public-works fleet operations.
